bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: correction_memory.apply_corrections() was unconditionally setting needs_review=False even when items had validation errors (math mismatch, missing name, etc.)
bugs_found_and_fixed.impact: Items with math mismatches that had corrections applied would show review_status='clean' instead of 'error'
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Changed to only clear needs_review if item has no validation_errors: `if not has_validation_errors: item['needs_review'] = False`
bugs_found_and_fixed.root_cause: The correction_memory service was designed to mark corrected items as 'learned' and not needing review, but it didn't account for items that still had validation errors after correction

critical_code_review_comments: compute_review_status correctly handles 3 cases: 1) needs_review explicitly set, 2) confidence_level set, 3) infer from raw data
The fix in correction_memory.py ensures validation errors are not masked by learned corrections
Frontend correctly uses review_status for row styling (red/amber backgrounds and left borders)

context_for_next_testing_agent: compute_review_status bug fix verified. Key change: function now infers needs_review from raw data when field is missing (handles old items). Also fixed correction_memory.py to not override needs_review when validation errors exist. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_compute_review_status.py

rca_of_the_issue.original_bug: Invoice-level review_status was 'clean' even when items had validation errors because compute_review_status only checked item.get('needs_review') which was None on old items
rca_of_the_issue.fix_in_preprocessing.py: compute_review_status now infers needs_review from raw data when field is missing: checks confidence_level, then checks math (qty*price=total), missing name, missing fields
rca_of_the_issue.additional_bug_found: correction_memory.apply_corrections() was unconditionally setting needs_review=False, masking validation errors
rca_of_the_issue.fix_in_correction_memory.py: Only clear needs_review if item has no validation_errors
rca_of_the_issue.verification: All 18 tests pass, frontend correctly shows red/amber indicators for error/warning invoices
